title: Thank You RBC Foundation
description: Pathways to Education recently surprised us with this video thanking the RBC Foundation for its support of the program. In turn, we'd like to thank them for their hard work in supporting youth education in low-income communities. It's amazing to see the effect their work is having!

asr.full_text: Hey RBC Foundation, my name is Deborah and I'm a Pathways student at Scarborough. Village. With your help this year I'm going to be graduating high school and I'm. Going to be going to Ryerson University. Thank you for everything, it's greatly. Appreciated. I would love to say a big thank you for giving us the funding that. We need to make the Pathways to Education possible. You guys are doing a. Great job, thank you so much. Thank you very much for your donations for helping. Me succeed through high school and on to post-secondary education. I am a Pathways. Student and I just want to say thank you for getting me to where I want to be. I. Really appreciate the support and all the opportunities that you've given me. Pathways is an amazing program to be part of and it helps a lot of students. Get through what they need to and I can't wait to graduate and go off to. University. Without our donors, Pathways wouldn't be anything because the donors. Really support the program and are the foundation so a big thank you to you. Guys.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because students express gratitude to the RBC Foundation for supporting Pathways to Education. The content discusses educational support, graduation, and post-secondary opportunities, while the closing frame reinforces the thank-you purpose rather than presenting a deceptive offer or solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Educational support and student progression through high school and post-secondary education are central to the content.
